_about: BLIND set for transcript → structured intake, written 2026-10-09 BEFORE running the engine on it. Same keys as extraction_cases.json. Styles the tuning set barely covers: English loanwords written in Devanagari by the Hindi recogniser, long multi-complaint turns, attendants speaking for the patient, past history next to current complaints, more duration/vital phrasings, false-alarm traps. Score it with: npm run test:extraction -- --set blind
